title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #14: Potrillo Mts., Kilbourne Hole and El Paso area
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#14" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "W. Potrillo Mts.", "E. Potrillo Mts.", "Kilbourne Hole", "El Paso", "sandy desert" and "Laguna de Guzman", with a dashed "U.S. MEXICO" border line across the upper half. A note in the upper right corner references a U.S. highway.
